reviews.text: Frequent customer here and for a good reason! They’re communicative, detail oriented, efficient, and above all else kind & personal with the dogs :) My pup & I recommend your grooming needs to be done here!

I'm a repeat customer!

They always consult with me about the cutting method, so I feel completely at ease entrusting my hair to them. (^^)

Thank you for your continued support!

My dogs are happy to go for grooming, so I feel at ease!
Even though I went to the store unexpectedly, they treated me very kindly. Thank you! 🐻

Thank you for your service during Ron's first haircut. You greeted us with a smile, and Ron seemed very happy. We've already booked an overnight stay for next month, so we look forward to seeing you again.

Despite the language barrier, the lady who looked after me understood exactly what I wanted and provided impeccable service. She took the initiative to use the translator, which is not a given. The atmosphere was lovely, with lots of happy, calm dogs.

My two dogs were so excited to go grooming today! ♪
They're always so kind to us. 🥰

This was my second time using their shampoo service, and my child's first time at kindergarten.

They did a fantastic job cleaning her!

I brought my Toy Poodle in for his first haircut! I'd always wanted to visit this shop because it's so cute, so I was really happy to finally go.

The finished result was adorable, and I'm very satisfied! Most importantly, when I picked him up, he was playing happily, which made me realize he had a relaxing and enjoyable experience.

I would definitely like to use their services again!

They gave my dog ​​a lovely trim!

It was very quick because there were two of them.

This was my first time using your services.

The grooming was done so beautifully!
Thank you so much!

The shop has a lovely atmosphere, and I was interested in it even before it opened. I've been going there ever since!
I've used both the grooming and boarding services, and they send me lots of photos and videos, which is reassuring and makes me happy!

Not only did she get a cute haircut, but her fur stays fluffy for a long time.

Also, it seems she's having a fun time with the other dogs while she's being looked after.

Although the results and value for money are not as good as the salon I used to go to, the staff are all very nice, and I feel good when I go to pick them up and when I leave, so I am currently going to this salon.

This was my first time using their grooming service!
The consultation was thorough, and they did a fantastic job, finishing my dog ​​so cutely just as I requested ♡
The groomer was so kind and I felt completely at ease leaving my dog ​​in their care, so I've recommended them to my friends ♡
I'll definitely be back next time!

This was my first time getting my dog ​​groomed here.
I'm very happy with the result; it's exactly as I imagined.
Thank you for the adorable photos!

We used their pet hotel and grooming services for our trip!

They looked after our dog for four days, and he was able to play freely and seemed to have a great time playing instead of being confined to a cage all the time!

They also sent us morning and evening updates with photos and videos, which gave our family great peace of mind!

We will definitely use their services again! ♡
This was my first time here. It was great! All the staff were so kind and helpful, explaining everything to me. Thank you so much! I'll definitely come again! I look forward to seeing you again!

Our three dogs are regular customers! After their shampoo, they get to play to their hearts' content in the indoor dog run before coming home, and all three of them fall fast asleep!
The dog run is supervised by an instructor, who also takes photos and videos, so it's a truly wonderful experience! (*^^*)

We always use your grooming and hotel services!

We are always very satisfied with the adorable grooming results you provide.

Not only do you carefully listen to our requests, but the staff are also very kind and gentle, and our dog seems relaxed every time, so we feel at ease leaving her in your care!

We look forward to seeing her fluffy and adorable appearance every time we pick her up!

This is our favorite grooming salon, and we hope to continue using it for a long time!

Thank you so much for always doing such a wonderful job.

We look forward to continuing to use your services in the future!
